candidate.answerReason: The unit-square steps give BC = 3 cm and place its line 2 cm outside WZ. The center O is another 5/2 cm from WZ, giving height 9/2 cm. Folding preserves area, so the required area is (1/2)(3)(9/2) = 27/4 cm².

methods.label: Fold to the known center
methods.explanation:
The fold replaces the unknown location of \(A\) with the known center \(O\). It leaves \(B\) and \(C\) fixed and preserves area, so \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle OBC\) have equal areas.

The large square has side length \(5\) cm because \(5^2=25\). The upper and lower unit-square steps leave one centimeter at each end of its five-centimeter height outside the span of \(BC\). Consequently,
\[
BC=5-1-1=3\text{ cm}.
\]
The two horizontal unit-square widths between the parallel lines \(BC\) and \(WZ\) make their separation \(2\) cm.

Since \(O\) is the center of the large square, its perpendicular distance from \(WZ\) is \(5/2\) cm. The line \(WZ\) lies between \(O\) and \(BC\), so the height of \(\triangle OBC\) with base \(BC\) is
\[
2+\frac52=\frac92\text{ cm}.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\operatorname{Area}(\triangle ABC)
=\operatorname{Area}(\triangle OBC)
=\frac12\cdot3\cdot\frac92
=\boxed{\frac{27}{4}\text{ cm}^2},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses folding as reflection, square area, addition and subtraction of lengths, and the elementary triangle-area formula.

candidate.annotationRationale: Reflection properties transfer the area calculation to the triangle with vertex O, and the triangle-area formula produces the requested value. Square area supplies the five-centimeter side; segment sums, differences, and the center's halfway position supply the base and height. No isosceles-triangle theorem or coordinate method is needed.

review.mathematicalCheck: The large square has side 5. The pictured unit-square incidences give BC = 5 − 1 − 1 = 3 and perpendicular separation 2 between BC and WZ. Thus O is 2 + 5/2 = 9/2 from BC. Folding fixes B and C and preserves area, giving area ABC = area OBC = (1/2)(3)(9/2) = 27/4 cm², choice C.
